description.en: An editorial look: a cream page, a serif face, small-caps labels over underlined fields and an ink-colored button. CSS only, so organization admins can install it.
The button, links and focused fields. A dark ink color suits the paper best.

theme.json.formCss:
<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  --background: 43 33% 94%;
  --foreground: 36 9% 11%;
  --card: 43 100% 99%;
  --card-foreground: 36 9% 11%;
  --muted: 42 30% 91%;
  --muted-foreground: 33 6% 38%;
  --accent: 42 30% 90%;
  --accent-foreground: 36 9% 11%;
  --border: 41 27% 84%;
  --input: 40 20% 74%;
  font-family: Charter, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, 'Noto Serif', 'Songti SC', serif;
}
.login-background {
  background: radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 50% 30%, #faf7f0 0%, transparent 70%), #f1ece1;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 430px;
}
.login-panel {
  padding: 44px 44px 16px;
  border: 1px solid #e4dccb;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: #fffdf8;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #e4dccb, 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(70, 50, 20, 0.25);
}
.login-logo-box {
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  padding-bottom: 24px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #ece5d6;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  background: transparent;
  border-radius: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
.signin-methods [role='tablist'] {
  gap: 22px;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  flex: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  color: #7a7468;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  font-style: italic;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  color: #1f1d1a;
  box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 #1f1d1a !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #6b655a;
  font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 42px;
  padding: 0 2px;
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #cdc4b1;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 17px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-bottom: 1px solid {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 {{accentColor}};
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border-color: #6b655a;
  border-radius: 0;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #fffdf8;
}
.login-form a {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-style: italic;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 46px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #fffdf8;
  font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  opacity: 0.86;
}
#footer {
  color: #8a8376;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
